headline: Suvidhaa Infoserve releases financial results for Q2 FY27
hook: Suvidhaa Infoserve reports September quarter financials
summary: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the NSE. The filing provides the company's performance metrics for the second quarter of the fiscal year. Retail investors can access the detailed balance sheet and profit-loss statement through the exchange portal.
why_it_matters: Quarterly performance data helps assess the company's current financial health.

headline: Suvidhaa Infoserve sets record date for rights issue
summary: Suvidhaa Infoserve Limited has informed the exchange that the record date for its upcoming rights issue is November 4, 2026. Shareholders holding shares as of this date will be eligible for the rights entitlement. The company has not disclosed the pricing or the quantum of the rights issue in this filing. Existing retail investors need to check their eligibility and decide whether to subscribe, renounce, or let their rights lapse.
whats_next: Rights issue subscription opening date to be announced
why_it_matters: Check holdings before November 4 for rights entitlement eligibility.
